bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Geopolitical instability in key markets; customer concentration risk (max 20% per client); FX volatility (mitigated by 3-year hedging); talent retention in competitive global market; reliance on deep cultural expertise in non-English markets; potential disruption from AI automation in engineering services.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident, visionary, and long-term oriented; leadership emphasizes 100-year vision, organic growth, and cultural moat; dismissive of short-termism; proud of 7,000% shareholder returns; tone is entrepreneurial, disciplined, and intellectually rigorous.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: NINtec’s true edge is not tech stack but cultural fluency in non-English European markets — enabling higher billing rates, multi-year contracts, and client stickiness that Indian peers cannot replicate; their 'R&D' is embedded in daily engineering work, not formalized spend, creating a lean, high-margin model.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- One of Asia-Pacific's deepest Claude engineering practices, with over 300 Claude-trained engineers delivering AI-native solutions across the software development lifecycle
- Blue-chip client franchise: 30+ Fortune 500 clients across nine industry verticals, with deep, long-standing relationships including Michelin, Toshiba, Veolia, Scania and Wolters Kluwer
- Proprietary six-phase AI Engineering Method integrating Anthropic's Claude, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf and Cursor, stated to enable 90%+ test coverage from sprint one and automated rollback within 90 seconds of deployment issues
- Independently certified quality and information-security frameworks (ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022), a prerequisite for enterprise-scale engagements
- Global delivery footprint - presence spanning 15 countries and customer reach across 30+ countries on five continents, anchored by a Netherlands subsidiary
- A defined policy for managing foreign exchange exposure, which management says minimises currency risk and results in stable earnings
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Intense and rising competition in IT support services — Management states that Information Technology support services remain an increasingly competitive business environment, and that the Company must keep expanding its operational scope and building on its service-delivery culture simply to remain competitive and retain trusted-partner status with customers.
- Foreign currency exposure on offshore revenue — The Indian IT industry is largely focused on markets outside India, so fluctuations in major currencies caused by unstable global economic conditions directly impact revenue and profits; the Company relies on a defined foreign-exchange management policy to keep earnings stable.
- Pace of technology change and obsolescence of the capability line — Emerging technology areas are shifting rapidly - towards cloud-based applications, big data & analytics, mobile systems and social media - and the Company has rebuilt its entire capability line around AI. A misjudged technology bet or slow adaptation would erode the differentiation the whole positioning rests on.
- Single-segment, single-activity concentration — The Company states it operates in only one segment, so segment-wise performance is not applicable. There is no second business line to buffer a downturn in enterprise software services demand.
- Cybersecurity, data protection and responsible AI adoption — The Chairman states that the Board pays close attention to risk, cybersecurity and the responsible, ethical adoption of AI across everything the Company builds, and that innovation must be matched by responsibility in how client data is protected - a structural exposure for a business embedding AI into client development lifecycles.
- Client-side execution risk: performance and integration with existing applications — Management notes that while businesses race to integrate IT into daily operations, user organisations are facing several challenges in terms of performance and integration with existing applications - a delivery and satisfaction risk that sits directly on engagements.
- Dependence on macro, regulatory and tax conditions across geographies — The cautionary statement records that the Company is dependent on factors that can impact operations, namely government regulations, tax regimes, and economic developments within India and other countries; results may differ from forward-looking statements.
- People dependence in a talent-led delivery model — Delivery rests on 441 permanent staff as of March 31, 2026 and on continuous training to enhance technical and behavioural skills; the Company's own risk framework covers operational, financial and strategic business risks, with teams authorised to manage them and the Board and Audit Committee reviewing risk assessment on a regular basis.

business.body: NINtec Systems Limited is a provider of consulting, technology, outsourcing and digital services, specialising in off/on-shore software product development, software migration, multimedia design & development, application development & maintenance and web designing for global enterprises undertaking digital transformation. The Company has rebuilt its capability line - application engineering, AI & machine learning, cloud analytics, testing, cybersecurity, blockchain, IoT, process automation and cognitive AI - with Anthropic's Claude embedded at the engineering core and delivered through a proprietary six-phase AI Engineering Method. It operates in a single segment, is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and has international operations including NINtec Systems B.V. in the Netherlands.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Software engineering services (single segment):** Off/on-shore software product development, Software migration, Application development & maintenance, Multimedia design & development, Web designing, AI & Machine Learning, Cloud Services / cloud analytics, Cognitive AI, Business Analytics, Blockchain, IoT, Cyber Security, Testing, Process automation
- **Methodology and practices:** Claude AI Engineering Practice (built around Anthropic's Claude), Six-phase AI Engineering Method (AI Discovery, Neural Architecture, Intelligent Development, Autonomous Testing, AI-Powered Deployment, Continuous Intelligence), Quantum Horizon initiative (post-quantum cryptography, quantum machine learning, quantum cloud computing on AWS Braket, Azure Quantum and IBM Qiskit)

outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Rebuild the entire capability line around AI rather than wrapping intelligence around existing services - Anthropic's Claude is embedded into every phase of the development lifecycle and the AI-first engineering methodology has been adopted company-wide.
- Long-term growth strategy is to continuously expand the addressable market, increase the customer base and deliver superior execution that gives clients an experience of digital transformation.
- Grow share of business with existing clients, which management says has the supplemental effect of reducing overhead and delivery costs.
- Expand operational scope to provide better services and capabilities, in order to remain competitive and continue being a trusted partner to customers.
- Identify offerings in new arenas such as cyber space, where the changing environment creates business opportunity.
- Invest ahead of the curve into cognitive AI and, at the frontier, quantum computing and post-quantum security - pursued through the Quantum Horizon initiative covering post-quantum cryptography, quantum machine learning and quantum cloud computing.
- Operate a flagship Claude AI Engineering Practice deployed across 10 service lines spanning AI & Machine Learning, Cloud Services, Cognitive AI, Business Analytics, Blockchain, IoT and Cyber Security.
- Strengthen board oversight and governance - the roles of Chairman and Managing Director were separated during the year, and quality and information-security frameworks are held to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 certification.
- Move aggressively towards a paperless corporate environment and use the latest technologies and newer means of storage to reduce waste.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: No capex project, plant, capacity addition or rupee capital-expenditure quantum is disclosed in this material. NINtec is an asset-light software services business: the Company states that its operations are not energy intensive and involve low energy consumption, and that it has presently not incurred any expense on Research & Development. Expansion is framed as market, capability and footprint build-out rather than physical capacity - the stated long-term growth strategy is to continuously expand the addressable market and increase the customer base, to expand operational scope in order to provide better services and capabilities, and to grow its share with existing clients, which management says will have the supplemental effect of reducing overhead and delivery costs. The footprint described is a headquarters in Ahmedabad, India with international operations including NINtec Systems B.V. in the Netherlands, a presence spanning 15 countries and customer reach across 30+ countries on five continents, serving 30+ Fortune 500 clients across nine industry verticals with over 300 Claude-trained engineers. The Company reports 1 wholly owned subsidiary as at March 31, 2026 with no companies becoming or ceasing to be subsidiaries, joint ventures or associates during the year, so no inorganic capacity or geography was added. The only capability-side build-out described is a methodology one: an AI-first engineering approach integrating Anthropic's Claude, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf and Cursor across a six-phase development process, plus an aggressive move towards a paperless corporate environment using newer means of storage.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Nasscom's Strategic Review 2026 estimates the Indian technology industry reaching revenue of US$ 315 billion in FY26, up 6.1% year-on-year, driven by growing adoption of artificial intelligence, cloud modernization and expansion of Global Capability Centres.
- Nasscom indicates continued growth momentum into FY2027 with technology spending growth projected in the 5-7% range year-on-year and AI investments moving from experimentation to industrial-scale deployment.
- FY2027 is expected to mark the maturation of AI spending, balancing near-term speed-to-market initiatives with long-cycle enterprise re-engineering.
- Over the coming years the industry is expected to see huge demand in cloud-based applications, big data & analytics, mobile systems and social media, and the global cloud market is expected to grow faster than overall IT.
- Government support is a stated tailwind: the India AI Mission has an approved outlay of more than Rs. 10,372 crore over five years with Rs. 1,000 crore allocated in the Union Budget 2026-27, alongside Rs. 20,000 crore earmarked for the Research, Development and Innovation Fund and a tax holiday to 2047 for data-centre infrastructure serving global markets.
- Small and medium business houses have started using IT with the emergence of cloud computing, widening the customer pool for providers that support and integrate company IT systems on an ongoing basis.
- Management sees demand for trusted partners who can engineer AI transformation responsibly and at scale as never having been greater, with global enterprises re-architecting themselves around AI.
- Competitive intensity is a stated headwind: IT support services remain an increasingly competitive business environment and user organisations face challenges of performance and integration with existing applications.
- Currency movements are a stated swing factor - the Indian IT industry is largely focused on markets outside India, so fluctuations in major currencies affect revenue and profits, though the Company has a defined foreign-exchange policy that it says results in stable earnings.
- The Company enters FY 2026-27 with what management describes as a strong balance sheet, a differentiated methodology and a world-class client base.
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers
